elements.note: Summary: the question; content: the answer as div.salt-rich-text. No item open. The section passes the group name faq-<section index> to the accordion, which writes it on each details (accordion.json), never on its own div. <section index> is the plan's index (view-props/_shared.json plan.index): the section's position among the page's rendered sections, counted from 0, as both platforms count it.

headings.headingBeforeOwn: no heading of its own and an answer contains a heading
headings.children: answer headings from the body base

zeroState: No FAQ with both a question and an answer.

notes.text: FAQPage structured data is emitted outside the markup (JSON-LD in the page graph); it is not part of this file.

formerly.note: No id; the WordPress section has no aria-labelledby.

owes: Write the block root div.salt-block with data-block set to the contract id inside the section wrapper (section.json).
Give the section heading the id <anchor>__heading and point the wrapper's aria-labelledby at it (section#labelled-by, SC-012).
Drop Tailwind utility classes from the markup; the shared stylesheets style the salt-* classes.
Answers wrapped in div.salt-rich-text; the intro paragraph.
Write the accordion's group name faq-<section index> on each details only, never on div.salt-accordion, with the index counted from 0 (plan.index).
